notes: «وكان، محمد بن جبير بن مطعم ذكر لي ذكرا من حديثه» tells Zuhri the matter; it is not a transmission of the saying, so Muhammad is not a link (he is in the scene)
Malik answers Zuhri's question inside the report; Malik is already the last link

fixes.reason: K6I lists Muhammad b. Jubayr between Ibn Shihab and Malik, but the text says he only mentioned a matter to Zuhri, not that he transmitted the report

evidence.quote: محمد بن جبير بن مطعم ذكر لي ذكرا من حديثه
محمد بن جبير بن مطعم بن عدي
